# Stage 23 Frontier Ledger

## Proved

If `nu_s(G_s)>=1-delta` and the nonlinear log-density remainder has
oscillation at most `m kappa` on `G_s`, then the normalized good-channel law
satisfies

```text
mu_{s,G}(A) <= exp(m kappa)/(1-delta) nu_s(A).
```

At the frozen centered Gaussian reference,

| quantity | value |
|---|---:|
| local radius | `0.0060231578076` |
| reference complement upper | `0.00279270808036` |
| local oscillation per support | `1.72203218e-5` |
| total loss per support | `3.01676133e-5` |
| target | `0.2` |

The former global-ball normalization obstruction is therefore absent for the
dependency-safe local event.

## Open

The Stage 21 covariance and Stage 22 remainder are centered finite-reference
certificates.  The same constants have not been proved uniformly for every
positive-mass retained nonlinear boundary state.  Consequently the complete
boundary-uniform `SU(2)` comparison and the full-measure bad probability are
open.  Strongest level: `C2` comparison theorem plus `C1` frozen calibration.
